# Azure Functions Knowledge

> Knowledge retrieval (RAG) decorators for Azure Functions Python v2.

**Retired and unsupported as of 2026-10-02.** No maintenance, fixes, or security
updates. Never published to PyPI by `yeongseon`; history, tags, and GitHub releases
are historical source snapshots only. A same-named PyPI project is not an
official release. No future publication or provider development is planned.

Historical Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit experiment: decorator-based knowledge
retrieval (RAG) with a pluggable provider registry and a built-in Notion provider.
The retained technical examples are reference material, not supported onboarding.

## Getting Started
- [Installation](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/knowledge/installation/): Retirement boundary and historical source setup.
- [Getting Started](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/knowledge/getting-started/): Minimal end-to-end example with the `input` and `inject_client` decorators.

## Overview
- [Home](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/knowledge/): Package overview, provider registry, and design.
